datastructures.name: Data Structures
datastructures.description: Visualizing fundamental data structures in 3D space
datastructures.qfep_connection: Data structures are entropy management strategies â€” each one trades different resources to minimize access cost. Trees compress search, hashes scatter for speed, heaps maintain partial order.

artifact_groups.rationale: Linear chains where nodes know only their next neighbor. Procedural construction mirrors list allocation — each node placed one at a time, pointer by pointer.
Binary recursion made spatial: chains fork into subtrees, every branch replicates the whole pattern. Recursive tree artifact embodies the self-similar structure.
Deterministic scattering: keys destroyed into buckets for O(1) lookup. The cost of speed is lost structure — order traded for instant access.
Tiered platforms enforcing parent-child dominance: almost-sorted order where the maximum always floats to the top. Priority queue as partial commitment to order.
Pure relations without hierarchy: any node can link to any other. Chaotic procedural terrain mirrors the graph's refusal to privilege any single path.
Disjoint set platforms that merge irreversibly: path compression and rank union optimize the question 'are these connected?' to near-constant time.
Shared prefix tree: one root branches into twenty-six children, enabling mid-keystroke autocomplete. Storage trades space for retrieval speed.
Recursive array halving: internal nodes store aggregates enabling O(log n) range queries. Lazy propagation defers work until it's truly needed.
Flat array where binary representation encodes reach: bit arithmetic replaces pointers, prefix sums update in O(log n) without tree overhead.
Sorted suffix indices flattening tree structure: O(log n) pattern search with minimal memory. The suffix array trades construction time for compact representation.
Recursive volume partitioning: binary spatial splits create rooms through subtraction rather than construction. The structure that powers Doom's rendering.
Spatial triage: divide space adaptively based on density, ignore uniformity. Quadtrees in 2D, octrees in 3D — resolution follows where the data clusters.
